name: hibira
description: Hibira realtime for coding agents and ChatGPT: the Hibira MCP server plus skills for wiring channels, push notifications, AI streaming, human approvals, waiting rooms and the Chat API into your app, adding the Live Chat widget and knowledge base, and asking a Gaya panel for a second opinion.

interface.longDescription: Hibira is hosted realtime for websites and apps: Pusher-compatible WebSocket channels, push notifications for iOS, Android and browsers, human approvals and virtual waiting rooms. Connect your Hibira account to list and create apps, get the setup guide for your stack with your app's values filled in, send a test event and watch it arrive, check usage, ask a person to approve a step, and run a waiting room for a ticket drop or flash sale. Skills cover adding live updates to a project, moving from Pusher and wiring push notifications. Hibira asks before creating apps, sending push notifications to real devices or changing a waiting room that people are in. Sign in with your Hibira account.
defaultPrompt: Add live order updates to this app with Hibira.
Move this project from Pusher to Hibira.
How much did my Hibira apps use this week?
